name: Lair of the Hydra
oracle_text:
If you control two or more other lands, this land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {G}.
{X}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0.
blocked_sentences: {X}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0

needs.what: a floor on an activated ability's announced X ("X can't be 0", i.e. X >= 1), so the CHOOSE_X question for an {X} mana cost on an activated ability starts at 1 instead of 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_keys has x_value (a defined X, never announced) but nothing that bounds an announced X; Game's activation path calls _ask_x with a hard-coded floor of 0, and the only min_x in the engine is the cast-lock floor from player_statics.cast_lock_min_x and the fixed min_x=1 inside ops_control. Without it the land could be animated as a 0/0 and die to state-based actions, which the printed card forbids. The rest of the line is expressible with animate (power/toughness {x}, colors G, subtypes Hydra, types Creature, duration this turn)
